transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what's been troubling you or what brings you in today?

I guess I’ve just been more tense and kind of down lately. I’ve been trying to clean up my image and routine for this arts board stuff, and… it’s been harder than I thought. I’m still doing the basic things, but I keep dropping little things I normally care about, like planning notes or design drafts. Then I feel bad about it and end up canceling plans instead of catching up.
Have you noticed that you’re not enjoying things that you normally like to do, like planning notes or design drafts, as much as you used to?

Yeah… a bit. I still care about them, I think, but since I started trying to get my image and routine together for the arts board stuff, I’ve been more tense and down than I expected. So things like fair planning notes or design drafts just… I don’t get into them the same way, and then I feel guilty and cancel plans instead of catching up.
Have you found that you don’t take pleasure in things you used to enjoy, like your art projects or planning events, even outside of the stress with the arts board?
I’m not really sure. I mean, outside of that stress… I haven’t noticed it as much, I guess. It’s hard to separate.

Outside of the stress related to your arts board responsibilities, have you noticed that you’re not getting the same enjoyment out of activities you used to like, such as art projects or planning events?
I don’t know… I haven’t really noticed that outside of the arts board stress. It’s mostly all kind of tied together for me right now.

Can you think of any activities outside of your arts board responsibilities that you used to enjoy, like hobbies or time with friends, where you’ve noticed you don’t get the same pleasure out of them lately?

Um… I can’t really think of anything specific. I still see friends sometimes, and I do little things, but I haven’t noticed it in a clear way outside of the arts board stuff. It’s mostly that whole situation that makes everything feel kind of… off.
Have you noticed any loss of interest or pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy, completely aside from the stress or responsibilities related to the arts board?
Not really… I mean, I haven’t noticed that separately. It’s hard to say, but nothing really comes to mind outside of that situation.
Have you noticed any loss of interest or pleasure in activities that you used to enjoy, even outside of the stress or pressure you're feeling about the arts board?
I don’t think so… not in a way I can separate from the arts board stuff. Nothing really stands out to me.
Can you describe if or when you’ve felt uninterested or unable to take pleasure in things you usually enjoy, outside of the stress you're experiencing with the arts board?

I don’t really have an example of that. I mean… if I’m not thinking about the arts board stuff, I can still enjoy things okay, I think. It’s just hard to separate sometimes, but nothing outside of that really stands out.

Outside of the stress and pressure from your arts board responsibilities, have you had days where you felt down or lost interest in things, even when there wasn’t any direct connection to that situation?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I have off days like anyone, but I haven’t really noticed it happening when it’s not tied to all that.
Have you noticed any feelings of anxiety or being on edge that aren’t related to your arts board responsibilities?
Not really… I haven’t noticed that outside of the arts board stuff. If I’m on edge, it usually feels connected to that.
Have you ever felt anxious or worried when there wasn’t anything specific going on, like when you're just relaxing or doing something you enjoy?
I don’t think so… not that I’ve really noticed. If I’m relaxing, I’m usually okay unless my mind goes back to that stuff.
Have you ever found yourself feeling anxious or worried even when there wasn’t anything specific to worry about, like when you’re just resting or doing something that usually calms you down?
I don’t think so… I mean, not when there’s really nothing going on. If I’m calm, I’m usually just calm.
Have you ever found yourself feeling anxious or worried even when there wasn’t anything specific going on, like when you're just resting or doing something that usually calms you down?
Not really. I guess I haven’t noticed that happening when there’s nothing specific going on.
Have you ever felt anxious or worried when there wasn’t anything specific on your plate, like when you’re just sitting quietly or enjoying a calm moment?
I don’t think so… if there’s really nothing going on, I’m usually not worried. At least, I haven’t noticed it.
Have you ever found yourself feeling anxious or worried even when there wasn’t anything specific going on, like when you’re just resting or doing something that usually calms you down?
I mean… I don’t think so. Not just out of nowhere. I haven’t really noticed that happening.
